Directories store terms, while Extrapoles (Extra fields) turn those terms into template fields.
1) In "Directory" set Code (base for placeholders and the DB column), Type and (for select/radio/checkbox) Values.
2) In "Terms list" add terms: Title (shown) and Value (stored code). Optionally mark the "default term".
3) In "Extra field" choose the insertion Location (pages/users/com, etc.). After saving, Seditio adds a column like tableprefix_{CODE} (page_{CODE}/user_{CODE}/com_{CODE}) and uses your terms when building select/radio/checkbox inputs.
Template placeholders: {XXX_CODE} — the extrapole value (in forms it is an input, on output it is term-resolved); {XXX_CODE_TITLE}, {XXX_CODE_DESC}, {XXX_CODE_MERA}, {XXX_CODE_VAL} (title/description/unit/raw value).
Leave empty — will use empty string or 0 (depending on field type). Enter a value — it will be used as DEFAULT.
If enabled and "Default value" is empty — column will be NULL without DEFAULT.
E.g.: UNSIGNED, ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, AUTO_INCREMENT, etc.
Optional. When set, submenu items are built automatically from this page category (see checkboxes below). Manual child items in the database are listed first, then auto items.

In "Menu manager" create menu items (Title), link each to a parent (Parent), and set URL, position and visibility (Visible).
Optional: set a page category as source to auto-build submenu from its subcategories and/or pages (requires Page module).
In public templates, the menu is rendered from sed_menu, where N is the parent menu item ID (menu_pid):
- {PHP.sed_menu.N.childrens} — full children tree (the parent itself is not shown)
- {PHP.sed_menu.N.childrensonlevel} — one level of children (the parent itself is not shown)
- {PHP.sed_menu.N.parent} — only the parent item.
